parsing_traps: STAPLED TRUST: Statement of Total Return and Portfolio Statement have 3 columns (Stapled Group / Far East H-REIT Group / Far East H-BT Group). The STAPLED GROUP column is canonical and used throughout.

Japan hotel FPN: in the Stapled Group it is carried as PPE (cost less depreciation) S$59,211k because the wholly-owned subsidiary Far East H-BT is the master lessee; the Far East H-REIT Group column instead carries it as an investment property at fair value S$63,968k. market_valuation uses the Stapled Group PPE carrying value 59,211k. Independent valuation JPY 7,790m (CBRE K.K.).

Portfolio Statement reconciliation: 12 SG investment properties at valuation = S$2,494,300k; + FPN PPE S$59,211k = S$2,553,511k. Marketing headline 'S$2.56 billion' corresponds to the H-REIT Group investment-property total S$2,558,268k.
Property-card valuations are in S$ million (FPN in JPY million); canonical valuations taken from the audited Portfolio Statement in $'000 (x1000).
